overview_description.description:
AntWalk is a video platform that equips professionals with learning and skills. Its up-skilling programs are delivered by top industry leaders and customized to meet the needs of ever-evolving organizations. Its platform is powered by 3,000+ Experts from 500+ Global Brands to provide professionals with an arsenal of Short Knowledge Bytes, Live Group Classes, and 1:1 Interactions with Experts. These enable them to learn in the flow of work, develop a growth mindset and propel their career to the next level.

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

about_short_description.short_description: AntWalk is a B2B Ed-Tech platform that helps offers employee up-skilling programmes and services.

product.name: Business Capability Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that supports capability building through assessments, learning content, and simulations to develop workforce skills aligned with business goals.

product.name: Custom Live Programs
product.description: Tailored live training sessions designed to address specific organizational needs and develop targeted skills in employees.

product.name: Assessments and Learning Needs Analysis
product.description: Role-specific assessments and learning needs analyses to identify skill gaps and align workforce capabilities with business objectives.

product.name: Self-Paced Learning Content
product.description: A library of on-demand courses and learning materials enabling employees to upskill at their own pace.

product.name: AI-Enabled Simulation and Role Play
product.description: Interactive AI-driven simulations and role plays designed to practice business scenarios and enhance decision-making skills.

product.name: Capability Academies
product.description: Structured academies focused on developing skills in specific domains like sales, customer success, finance, leadership, and technology.
